faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about DripCatch.
faq.q1: Do I need to connect my bank account?
faq.a1: Never. Unlike conventional budgeting apps, DripCatch does not ask for your bank credentials or open banking tokens. Your records remain private.
faq.q2: How do shared subscription splits work?
faq.a2: When creating a subscription, toggle 'Split Cost' and assign amounts to friends. You can invite them via email so they see their share and status.
faq.a3: A zombie subscription is a service you keep paying for on autopilot but haven't actively used in months. Marking it as a zombie isolates your potential savings.
faq.q4: Which currencies and billing frequencies are supported?
faq.a4: DripCatch supports EUR, USD, and regional currencies, along with weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly billing frequencies.
faq.a5: Yes, core ledger tracking, price hike detection, and split management are completely free.

description.title: 2. Description of Service
description.p1: DripCatch provides a manual and preset subscription ledger, cadence normalizer, and zombie detector to track recurring outflows and model projections.
description.clarificationText: DripCatch is an informational ledger only. It is not a bank, broker, payment gateway, escrow service, or regulated financial, accounting, or tax advisor.

sharedSubscriptions.title: 3. Shared Subscriptions & Split Disclaimer
sharedSubscriptions.intro: Subscription split tracking and collaborative features are provided purely as bookkeeping coordination tools.
sharedSubscriptions.bullet1: Zero Fund Processing: DripCatch never moves, holds, escrows, or transfers funds between users.
sharedSubscriptions.bullet2: All peer-to-peer reimbursements happen entirely off-platform (via cash, SEPA, Revolut, etc.).
sharedSubscriptions.bullet3: DripCatch assumes zero liability for unpaid shares, co-payer disputes, chargebacks, or non-reimbursement between users.

accounts.title: 4. User Accounts & Data Accuracy
accounts.content: You are required to supply accurate account credentials. Users remain solely responsible for the precision of manual inputs, including billing dates, renewal costs, and currency selections.

acceptableUse.title: 5. Acceptable Use & Anti-Abuse
acceptableUse.intro: To protect our platform and users, you agree strictly to prohibit:
acceptableUse.bullet1: Unsolicited split invitations or spamming emails through the invitation tool.
acceptableUse.bullet2: Automated scraping, reverse engineering, or any form of platform abuse.

warranties.title: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties & "As-Is" Provision
warranties.content: The platform is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. Projections (such as 12-month forecasts and price creep estimators) are estimates and do not constitute guarantees of future cash flow.

liability.title: 7. Limitation of Financial Liability
liability.content: Users remain solely responsible for canceling their own subscriptions before renewal deadlines and verifying price hike alerts against actual merchant invoices. DripCatch accepts no liability for overdraft fees, unexpected merchant renewals, unmonitored price increases, or service interruptions.

termination.title: 8. Termination & Account Cancellation
termination.content: Users may delete their account at any time via settings or request. DripCatch reserves the right to suspend accounts violating acceptable use policies.

governingLaw.title: 9. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
governingLaw.content: These terms are governed by the standard EU and French commercial law framework applicable to consumer web software.
